evidence: Saved queue entry at challenges/cases/v47/v47-drop-wished-dagger-to-sell-in-generated-shop-attempt7-pager-corrected-cfirst.session.json identifies the stop at segment 0, step 48, with 3 remaining screens; step 48 key `o` displays “You drop a dagger.--More--”, step 49 space displays the shopkeeper offer, and step 50 `y` records the sale.

The immutable recipe challenges/cases/v47/v47-drop-wished-dagger-to-sell-in-generated-shop-attempt7-pager-corrected-cfirst.recipe.session.json independently sets up a wizard, creates a shop, wishes a +5 dagger, then drops it and accepts the sale.

C source src/do.c:dropx (786-797) extracts inventory, checks shipping and altar effects, then calls dropy(); dropz (806-843) places the object and calls sellobj(obj, u.ux, u.uy) for shop levels before stackobj(). The JavaScript preflight_dropx() at js/do.js:1897-2100 rejects costly_spot() at :1956 before ordinary placement; dropzAdmitted() records the shk.c:sellobj gap only inside its withImpact branch at :2205-2209.

C source src/shk.c:sellobj() (3927-4128) is a void shop-sale function with ordinary costly-spot eligibility, sale pricing, shopkeeper state, offer and confirmation branches, and payment/billing effects. The current js/shk.js has no sellobj() declaration; rg confirmed existing related helpers including costly_spot(), saleable(), set_cost(), record_price_quote(), and sellobj_state().

Investigation is partial because the safe reload pause arrived before full direct-callee and entry-point analysis, source reservation, or edits; no game code was changed and no tests, recordings, or fresh differentials were started.
